pipe.commaFound: Trailing comma found and removed. Remaining: {text}
pipe.commaNone: No trailing comma found, text unchanged.
pipe.parseFail: json.loads() raises: {error}. Repair pass exhausted its options, this is a real failure, not something more regex fixes. Correct move: retry the model or reject, not more repair.
pipe.validMissing: Parsed successfully, but missing: {missing}. This is a validation failure, not a repair-pass failure, the JSON was syntactically fine the whole time.
